video_title: Perk Says Young Athletes No Longer Have Time for Multiple Sports

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues high school basketball is becoming obsolete
quotes.excerpt: In my opinion, high school basketball is dead.
quotes.quote: If you are talking about taking basketball to the next level, high school basketball in my opinion is dead. You see now so many people are transitioning. They are either at private schools. How was Rondo able to play varsity basketball as an eighth grader, Rondo?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Young athletes are training year-round to stay competitive
quotes.excerpt: The game has changed so much is that these kids are working out around the clock.
quotes.quote: Nowadays, the game has changed so much is that these kids are working out around the clock. If you don't get with it, you are going to get left behind because it is the way of life. Kids are working around the clock now. Kids are not saying I am going to school to learn Spanish or social studies. In the eighth grade, I remember we had to take Texas history in order to get to high school. I can't tell you one thing about the Alamo, but I could have been in the lab working on my game.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Specializing in one sport is necessary for young athletes
quotes.excerpt: I don't think you have a choice. I believe that if you are a football player, because football is damn near year-round too.
quotes.quote: I don't think you have a choice. I believe that if you are a football player, because football is damn near year-round too. They have flag football national tournaments. So you don't have time to be a two-sport athlete. The only thing you could do for being a two-sport athlete in my opinion, if you are a football player then you could run track. If you are a basketball player then you could run track. You could always add track in there for as with your main sport.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Elite young athletes require personal trainers to succeed
quotes.excerpt: There is not one player out there that is top ranked that doesn't have a personal trainer.
quotes.quote: There is not one player out there that is top ranked or that is in the conversation of being an elite athlete or have a bright future that doesn't have a personal trainer. Am I lying, Rondo? A personal one-on-one trainer.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the benefits of playing multiple sports
quotes.excerpt: I encourage you to play other sports just to learn gamesmanship, the physicality of like whether you play football.
quotes.quote: Quarterbacks can play baseball, that makes sense. A lot of wide receivers, running backs, those guys will do track for football. Basketball, I would tell people, I encourage you to play other sports just to learn gamesmanship, the physicality of like whether you play football or lacrosse or even soccer. Those things are great. Once they get seven, eight, nine, even freshman year seven, eight, that is when you are going to start to see they are going to say, I can't keep up with what is happening unless they are an elite talent.
